verdict.rationale: Zep's core product function is adding conversation memory (thread.add_messages ingests into user-level knowledge graph) and retrieving it via semantic+BM25 hybrid graph search with sub-200ms latency, explicitly enabling context persistence across sessions/threads. This is well documented with concrete API examples and even independent community discussion of the underlying temporal-graph approach and its evolution from earlier fact-extraction methods. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks validating recall quality/accuracy at scale beyond vendor claims.
